correction.unexpected_exception_rule: Archive the attempt-specific provider audits, write no trajectory and no replaceable failure artifact, mark the shard metadata interrupted_unclassified_failure, and stop immediately for diagnosis.
correction.resume_rule: After a diagnosed infrastructure or implementation interruption, resume the same task in the same run root; do not advance the deterministic replacement sequence until that task has either an admissible trajectory or a frozen replaceable outcome.
correction.canonicalizer_rule: Accept as exclusions only failure artifacts carrying one of the three exact frozen failure kinds and matching error or exception conditions. Reject missing, duplicate, unexpected, or post-target outcomes.
